sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/Saint-Johnsville (park record and availability for 1 night from 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19, 2 adults, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Campsite with hookups and electric $45/night, $275/week, $500/2 weeks, $850/month; seasonal $2,700. Tent site $25. Campspot charged $48.45 a night for every RV site type in June 2027 (weekday and Saturday alike), which includes its booking fee.

fees.source: https://sjvny.org/departments/marina/ (Marina and Campground Fees: 'CAMPSITE PER NIGHT (INCLUDES HOOKUP & ELECTRIC) $45.00', '1 WEEK $275.00', '2 WEEKS $500.00', '1 MONTH $850.00', 'SEASONAL CAMPING $2,700.00') + https://www.campspot.com/book/Saint-Johnsville (averagePricePerNight 48.45 for 'Standard full hookup RV Site' and 'Waterfront full hookup RV Site', 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campspot, or the marina office; seasonal, weekly and monthly stays by enquiry. Maximum rental 1 month unless management authorizes longer.

booking.source: https://sjvny.org/departments/marina/ (links https://www.campspot.com/book/Saint-Johnsville; 'The maximum rental period is 1 month, unless authorized by management'; 'Please let us know if you are interested in a seasonal, weekly, or monthly stay') + Campspot availability 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19 (all RV types AVAILABLE), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campspot sells 19 RV sites, all full-hookup pull-throughs (4 of them waterfront), plus 15 primitive tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/Saint-Johnsville ('Standard full hookup RV Site' 15 sites, 'Waterfront full hookup RV Site' 3 + 1, all 'Pull-Through'; 'Primative tent site' 15), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://sjvny.org/departments/marina/ ('ALL OF THE ABOVE RATES INCLUDE WATER, SHOWER, AND RESTROOMS. A COIN-OPERATED LAUNDRY FACILITY IS ALSO AVAILABLE'; 'RV DUMP STATION') + Campspot (every site 'Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-21

note: Village of St. Johnsville marina campground on the Mohawk River/Erie Canal (~1 mi E of Lock 16). Active rail line adjacent (train noise). --Claude
summary: Village page confirms $45/night with hookups (Campspot $48.45 incl. its fee, June 2027), season May 1 - Oct 18 (new), Campspot booking (new), 1-month maximum; Campspot confirms 30/50 A full hookups, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi; showers, laundry, dump confirmed. Note: dropped site/hookup/facility/season/daily-seasonal restatements. Site count 28 (derived) left: Campspot sells 19 RV sites and the page gives no total.
